pages.text: Sarcophagi functions the same as beds, but instead of sleeping through the night, you sleep through the day instead.

pages.title: Cushioning
pages.text: You can also cushion your sarcophagus by right-clicking on it with wool, making it more comfortable to lay in. You can also change the color of the cushions by right-clicking the sarcophagus with dye, or remove the cushions by using Shears.
